title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at D'Youville University, from historic campus landmarks to modern wellness centers and community gardens.

cards.title: Hang Out at The Park
cards.subtitle: Koessler Administration Building
cards.notes: Visit this 24/7 student lounge to relax in modern booths, meet the campus mascots, or study with friends in a historic setting.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 student lounge and advocacy space located inside the historic Koessler Administration Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Park Advocacy center is open 24/7. Providing students with a safe space to speak up about their anxieties, hang out with friends.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for D'Youville students with university ID.

cards.title: Work Out for Free
cards.subtitle: D'Youville Academic Center
cards.notes: Access cardio equipment on the 6th floor or hit the free weights in the basement. Just bring your student ID for entry.
cards.short_summary: A multi-level campus fitness facility offering cardio, weights, and a plyometric studio for the university community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center, open to all campus community members, has moved to the D'Youville Academic Center. Free weights and machines are located in the basement.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM and weekends 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM for students and staff.

cards.title: Relax at the Wellness Lodge
cards.subtitle: Koessler Administration Building, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Drop in for free yoga, meditation sessions, or chair massages designed to help students de-stress between classes.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated campus space for holistic health, offering free wellness activities and relaxation areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit the 3rd floor of KAB for events including yoga, meditation, art, chair massages, or to come relax and reset.
cards.access_notes: Available to all D'Youville students during scheduled wellness hours.

cards.title: Visit the Community Garden
cards.subtitle: 222 Connecticut Street
cards.notes: Explore the campus greenhouse and raised beds. It's a peaceful green space where students can learn about urban gardening.
cards.short_summary: A campus community garden and greenhouse providing green space and fresh produce for the university.
cards.evidence_claim: The DYU Campus Community Garden... features raised beds and a greenhouse... The garden is open to all students as a place to learn or simply enjoy green space.
cards.source_title: Urban Farm Day - Gardens Buffalo Niagara
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; specific volunteer hours may apply for harvesting.

cards.title: Study in the Hub Atrium
cards.subtitle: Health Professions Hub
cards.notes: Enjoy the natural light and public art in this modern 'main street' space. It's a top spot for collaborative student work.
cards.short_summary: A bright, community-focused atrium featuring public art and collaborative gathering spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The atrium serves as a 'main street' for the building... Public art helps beautify the building and the community.
cards.source_title: D'Youville University - Health Professions Hub - SCUP
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible building with dedicated student and community gathering zones.

cards.title: Play at the Saints Center
cards.subtitle: 329 Porter Avenue
cards.notes: Join intramural sports or use the open gym hours to shoot hoops. Admission is free for students with a valid ID.
cards.short_summary: The home of D'Youville athletics, offering open gym time and intramural sports for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The gymnasium offers open gym and intramurals throughout the academic year. Students and staff receive free admission.
cards.access_notes: Free for students with university ID during scheduled open gym hours.

cards.title: Quiet Time at the Chapel
cards.subtitle: Koessler Administration Building
cards.notes: Find a moment of peace in this historic chapel or the adjacent all-faiths prayer room, open to all students for reflection.
cards.short_summary: A historic on-campus chapel and all-faiths prayer room providing a quiet space for spiritual reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: It's also where you'll find the Sacred Heart Chapel and our all-faiths prayer room.
cards.access_notes: Open to students and the public for prayer and reflection.

cards.title: Reserve a Private Study Room
cards.subtitle: Montante Family Library
cards.notes: Book a quiet room for group projects or solo study. These spaces are free for students and often include whiteboards.
cards.short_summary: Private and group study rooms available within the campus library for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: If you need specific services like reserving a study room... book at least a day or two in advance.
cards.source_title: How Can Students Reserve Study Space At D Youville Library?
cards.access_notes: Reservable online for current students; library hours typically extend until 10:00 PM on weekdays.

cards.title: Take a Free Cooking Class
cards.subtitle: Health Professions Hub
cards.notes: Learn to cook healthy, medically tailored meals at no cost. Classes are led by the Department of Nutrition and Dietetics.
cards.short_summary: A demonstration kitchen offering free nutritional cooking classes to students and the community.
cards.evidence_claim: A demonstration kitchen offering free cooking classes and medically tailored meals to improve nutrition.
cards.access_notes: Free classes available by registration; open to students and the public.

cards.title: Visit the Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: 305 Koessler Administration Building
cards.notes: Engage with diverse student groups and attend free social events aimed at fostering an equitable campus community.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub for social engagement, cultural events, and student support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Join us to engage, learn, and contribute to a more equitable campus community... Cultural Enrichment Center Office: 305 KAB.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during standard university business hours.
